message: 変化

name: Shio
message: 「Tuh! Tah! Yah!」

name: Shio
message: 「Begone, vile foes! Yah! Tuh! Taaah!」
She's really fired up. And it's so graceful, almost like she's dancing.
Azel is completely absorbed in filming her, too.

name: Shio
message: 「Dei! Tuah! Oryaaaah!」

name: Shio
message: 「Taaah!」
Shio-chan noticed me and stopped.

name: Synn
message: 「You're really fired up.」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono. Good morning to you.」

name: Shio
message: 「A-Azel-dono is here as well?! How careless of me!」

name: Synn
message: 「It just means you were that focused.」

name: Shio
message: 「No matter how focused I was, failing to even sense your presence is nothing short of my own lack of discipline. I have shown you a most shameful sight.」

name: Shio
message: 「Um... wouldn't recording my unrefined techniques be rather dull?」

name: Azel
message: 「If it were dull, I wouldn't film it.」

name: Synn
message: 「She means it's not dull at all.」

name: Shio
message: 「...Even so, my skills are still immature compared to my seniors in the Naginata Club. To think I would let myself get so needlessly worked up over something so trivial.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something happen?」

name: Shio
message: 「Whenever I recall that lecherous scoundrel at KiraFes who hit on girls indiscriminately and left after mocking me, I cannot help putting extra force into my swings.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, that weird guy.」

name: Man
message: 「To set a maiden's blood racing with such heat... truly, I am a sinful man.」
He had said some strangely suggestive things about Azel, too.

name: Man
message: 「To think that you, of all people, would seek to leave behind a record of this world.」
Even if I asked what happened between her and that weird guy, Azel probably wouldn't tell me, though.

name: Synn
message: 「In the end, you're the one who drove him off, Shio-chan.」

name: Shio
message: 「No, that man chose to back down.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Shio
message: 「I had believed that my lapse was merely due to underestimating him as a frivolous flirt, and that without such a gap in my guard, I could have apprehended him, however.」
Shio-chan bit her lip in frustration.

name: Shio
message: 「The more I replayed our movements and practiced forms to see how I might have captured him, the clearer it became: someone like me could never have apprehended that man.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way.」

name: Shio
message: 「No, I can tell. Even the fact that that man did not display so much as one ten-thousandth of his true strength.」

name: Shio
message: 「There truly are terrifying individuals in this world. And my own immaturity for failing to even recognize that. I am far too green!」

name: Shio
message: 「I am so mortified and frustrated by my own pathetic self--getting flustered, tensing up, and growing pointlessly hot-headed--that I can scarcely bear it.」

name: Azel
message: 「If you can move like that, it's already impressive.」

name: Shio
message: 「However.」

name: Azel
message: 「At the very least, it made me want to take your picture.」
With that, Azel turned away and walked off with brisk steps, almost as if she were angry.

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, I don't really know much about the naginata or anything, but I don't think realizing where your strength stands right now is a bad thing.」

name: Shio
message: 「That is certainly true, yet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, you know, I don't think there's any point in comparing yourself to someone else.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone moves forward at their own pace, so I don't think there's any need to force yourself to match theirs. Because you're you, Shio-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for acting like a know-it-all when I'm just an amateur! See you later, Shio-chan!」
As I broke into a run after Azel, Shio-chan's voice reached me from behind.

name: Shio
message: 「Your words have struck deep into my heart, Synn-dono! Also, please convey to Azel-dono that I am deeply grateful for her consideration!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
I spotted her back and called out, yet Azel didn't even pause.

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan says thank you.」
Azel quickened her pace even more.
She's embarrassed--at herself for not being able to stop herself from saying something to cheer up a dejected Shio-chan.
Ever since getting into photography, Azel has been changing. At least, that's how it feels to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't recall doing anything to earn that girl's gratitude.」
He finally catches up and walks alongside her.

name: Synn
message: 「I only passed the message along. Also, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「...What.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's someone who wants you to take their photo, Azel--think you could do it?」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」
